description: This file defines the MWAAClient class, which extends the AwsClient class to interact with the Amazon MWAA service API. It includes method annotations specifying available synchronous and asynchronous methods for managing environments, tokens, and resources related to MWAA.

classes.name: MWAAClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon MWAA service. It extends AwsClient and provides methods for actions like creating, deleting, and managing MWAA environments and resources.

methods.name: createCliToken
methods.description: Creates a CLI token for MWAA environment.

methods.name: createCliTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a CLI token for MWAA environment.

methods.name: createEnvironmentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new MWAA environment.

methods.name: createWebLoginToken
methods.description: Creates a Web login token for MWAA environment.

methods.name: createWebLoginTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a Web login token.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves details of an MWAA environment.

methods.name: invokeRestApi
methods.description: Invokes a specified REST API within MWAA.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.
